# Walk-In Tubs 4 Less

> Online walk-in tub store of Aging Safely Baths (Denver, Colorado). Every tub can be bought two ways: Supply only (shipped by freight to the buyer's curb or driveway in the US or Canada, with free phone tech support for the installer) or Fully installed (factory-certified installer; a full site visit before install; old tub removed and hauled away; 1 day in most homes). Prices are given by itemized written quote; no card checkout online. Phone 1-888-779-2284.

Parent company: Aging Safely Baths (https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/), legal name Aging Safely Baths & More, LLC, BBB A+ accredited since 2012, Google rating 4.9 (35 reviews, Oct 2026). Hours 7am to 8pm Mountain, 7 days. Email sales@agingsafelybaths.com.
Machine-readable business facts: https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/facts.json
Installed walk-in tub jobs: no published price; installed pricing depends on the bathroom and the model, quoted free in writing. Supply-only prices: by written quote.
Process: itemized written quote by phone or from photos; no high-pressure sales visit; a factory-certified tech does a full site visit before an installed job.
Warranty: each maker's terms apply. Hydro Dimensions: lifetime on shell, frame, finish, door seal, motors and controls. Ella's Bubbles: lifetime on shell, frame and door gasket. Meditub: 10 years on shell, lifetime door seal. Rane: 5 years on shell, lifetime door seal. ANZZI: lifetime on the door seal.
Updated: 2026-11-17

## Brands
- [Hydro Dimensions](https://walkintubs4less.com/brands/hydro-dimensions/): 17 models. Best value: broadest warranty, everyday sizes.
- [Ella's Bubbles](https://walkintubs4less.com/brands/ellas-bubbles/): 30 models. Transfer doors, two-seat, lay-down, tall or larger bathers.
- [Meditub](https://walkintubs4less.com/brands/meditub/): 14 models. Matching an exact footprint; WCA wheelchair models.
- [Rane by Bestbath](https://walkintubs4less.com/brands/rane/): 5 models. Made in USA; wheelchair and lift transfers; heavy use.
- [ANZZI](https://walkintubs4less.com/brands/anzzi/): 14 models. Lowest cost; supply only with a handy installer.

## Guides
- [How to Buy a Walk-In Tub Online Without Getting Burned](https://walkintubs4less.com/guides/buy-walk-in-tub-online/): Buying a walk-in tub online? Check door and drain side, curbside vs white glove freight, delivery inspection and return terms before you pay.
- [Home Depot, Lowe's and Costco Walk-In Tubs vs Buying From a Dealer](https://walkintubs4less.com/guides/home-depot-lowes-costco-walk-in-tubs/): What Home Depot, Lowe's and Costco walk-in tub listings actually include: delivery, installation, warranty and returns, compared with a dealer.
- [Walk-In Tub Rough-In and Spec Sheet Decoder](https://walkintubs4less.com/guides/walk-in-tub-rough-in-specs/): Walk-in tub rough-in explained: drain location, door clearance, GFCI circuits, filled weight, leveling and access panels, from real spec sheets.
- [Walk-In Tub Delivery: Will It Fit Through My Door?](https://walkintubs4less.com/guides/walk-in-tub-delivery-will-it-fit/): Most walk-in tubs are 26 to 32 inches wide. How to measure doors, halls and turns, and curbside vs white glove walk-in tub delivery explained.
- [Walk-In Tub Statistics 2026: Real Numbers, Every One Sourced](https://walkintubs4less.com/guides/walk-in-tub-statistics/): Walk-in tub statistics for 2026 from Census, CDC, AARP and CPSC, plus product counts from 71 tubs. Every number sourced, with myths flagged.
- [Used Walk-In Tub for Sale? What to Check Before You Buy](https://walkintubs4less.com/guides/used-walk-in-tub-for-sale/): Thinking about a used walk-in tub? Check warranty transfer, door seal, drain, jets and fit, and compare the real cost with a new supply-only tub.

## Facts we state carefully
- Original Medicare generally does not cover walk-in tubs.
- No bathing product eliminates the risk of falls; walk-in tubs are designed to reduce risk when installed and used properly.
- Specs come from manufacturers' published spec sheets and factory drawings.
